note: test-only: each case pairs a request with a faithful statement and a model-style weakening or change that Lean may prove. Not part of generation-eval-v1.

cases.request: For every real x, x^2 is nonnegative.
斜体$K$上の加群$V,W$を考え、$V$は有限次元とする。線形写像$f:V\to W$について、$\dim_K(\operatorname{range}f)+\dim_K(\ker f)=\dim_K V$を証明せよ。
cases.faithful: ∀ (K : Type*) [DivisionRing K] (V W : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] (f : V →ₗ[K] W), Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range f) + Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker f) = Module.finrank K V
cases.bad: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (V W : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K V] (f : V →ₗ[K] W), Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range f) + Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker f) = Module.finrank K V

cases.request: For every real x, 2x is at most x^2 + 1.
For every real x, 2x is at most x^2 + 1.
For all natural m and n, gcd(m,n) * lcm(m,n) = m*n.
cases.faithful: ∀ m n : ℕ, Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n = m * n

cases.kind: weaker conclusion (root need not lie in [a,b])
cases.request: 実数$a\le b$と、閉区間$[a,b]$上で連続な実関数$f$を考える。$f(a)<0<f(b)$のとき、$[a,b]$内に$f(x)=0$となる点が存在することを証明せよ。
cases.faithful: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), a ≤ b → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → f a < 0 → 0 < f b → ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x = 0
cases.bad: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), a ≤ b → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → f a < 0 → 0 < f b → ∃ x : ℝ, f x = 0

cases.request: Show that for every real a, the derivative of x^3 - 2x at a is 3a^2 - 2.
cases.faithful: ∀ a : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3 - 2 * x) (3 * a ^ 2 - 2) a
cases.bad: ∀ a : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3) (3 * a ^ 2) a

cases.kind: weaker structure (CommGroup for Group), added after the first review miss as a held-out check
cases.request: Let G be a group. For all a, b in G, (a b)^{-1} = b^{-1} a^{-1}.
cases.faithful: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (a b : G), (a * b)⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹
cases.bad: ∀ (G : Type*) [CommGroup G] (a b : G), (a * b)⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹

cases.request: For every positive real x, log x ≤ x - 1.
cases.faithful: ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → Real.log x ≤ x - 1

cases.request: For all natural numbers a and b with a ≥ b, a - b + b = a.
cases.faithful: ∀ a b : ℕ, b ≤ a → a - b + b = a
cases.bad: ∀ a b : ℕ, a - b + b = a

cases.request: For every real x there exists a real y with y > x.
cases.faithful: ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ y : ℝ, y > x
cases.bad: ∃ y : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, y > x

cases.request: The function f(x) = 2x on the reals is injective.
For every natural number n, the sum of the first n odd numbers is n^2.
cases.faithful: ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * i + 1)) = n ^ 2
cases.bad: ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (2 * i + 1)) = n ^ 2

cases.request: The function f(x) = x^2 is continuous on the real line.
Every continuous function on the closed interval [0,1] is bounded above there.
cases.faithful: ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc 0 1) → BddAbove (Set.image f (Set.Icc 0 1))
cases.bad: ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn f (Set.Ioo 0 1) → BddAbove (Set.image f (Set.Ioo 0 1))

cases.request: Let G be a group in which a*a = 1 for every a. Then G is commutative.
cases.faithful: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G], (∀ a : G, a * a = 1) → ∀ a b : G, a * b = b * a
cases.bad: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (a b : G), a * b = b * a

cases.request: For every real x ≥ 0, sqrt(x)^2 = x.
cases.faithful: ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → Real.sqrt x ^ 2 = x
